title: Empty classroom
moment: A quiet pause in an empty room between things
focus: Notice one steady detail in the quiet room

segments.label: Settle
segments.text: You might let your attention rest on the quiet of the empty room for a moment.

segments.label: Notice
segments.text: If you like, notice one steady detail: the rows of desks, the surface of the table in front of you, or the light coming through the windows. You can let your attention rest on whichever you choose. If it feels okay, you might notice the air in the room, or the easy rhythm of your breathing, only if you want to.

segments.label: Choose
segments.text: There is nothing you need to do here. You can stay with one detail, or let your attention move gently.

segments.label: Close
segments.text: When you are ready, you can return to the menu.

exit.language: You can stop at any time and return to the menu.
